import numpy as np
import h5py
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

# Parameters
sessions = range(1, 11)
epoch_tmin, epoch_tmax = -0.1, 0.3  # seconds
baseline = (-0.1, 0.0)
m100_window = (0.05, 0.15)  # seconds

# Collect latency per session and channel
records = []
for ses in sessions:
    with h5py.File(f'sub-0_ses-{ses}_meg.h5', 'r') as f:
        data = f['data'][:]; times = f['times'][:]
        ch_names = [c.strip() for c in f.attrs['channel_names'].split(',')]
        ch_types = [t.strip() for t in f.attrs['channel_types'].split(',')]
    mags = [i for i,t in enumerate(ch_types) if t=='mag']
    ev = pd.read_csv(f'sub-0_ses-{ses}_events.tsv', sep='\t')
    onsets = ev.loc[ev['kind']=='word','timemeg'].values
    # Epoch parameters
    sfreq = 1/(times[1]-times[0])
    n_samp = int(round((epoch_tmax-epoch_tmin)*sfreq)) + 1
    off = int(round(epoch_tmin * sfreq))
    b0 = int(round((baseline[0]-epoch_tmin)*sfreq)); b1 = int(round((baseline[1]-epoch_tmin)*sfreq))
    w0 = int(round((m100_window[0]-epoch_tmin)*sfreq)); w1 = int(round((m100_window[1]-epoch_tmin)*sfreq))
    # Extract epochs and compute evoked
    epochs = []
    for t0 in onsets:
        idx = np.searchsorted(times, t0) + off
        end = idx + n_samp
        if idx<0 or end>data.shape[1]: continue
        ep = data[mags, idx:end]
        ep = ep - ep[:, b0:b1].mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        epochs.append(ep)
    epochs = np.stack(epochs, axis=0)
    evoked = epochs.mean(axis=0)
    tvec = np.linspace(epoch_tmin, epoch_tmax, evoked.shape[1])
    # Latency per channel
    for ch_i, ch in enumerate(np.array(ch_names)[mags]):
        sig = evoked[ch_i, w0:w1]
        peak_idx = np.argmax(np.abs(sig))
        lat = tvec[w0 + peak_idx]
        records.append({'session': ses, 'channel': ch, 'latency': lat})

# Build DataFrame and pivot
df = pd.DataFrame(records)
df_pivot = df.pivot(index='session', columns='channel', values='latency')
channels = df_pivot.columns.tolist()

# Split-half reliability: sessions 1-5 vs 6-10
split1 = df_pivot.loc[1:5]
split2 = df_pivot.loc[6:10]
reliability = []
for ch in channels:
    x = split1[ch].values
    y = split2[ch].values
    if np.isnan(x).any() or np.isnan(y).any():
        r, p = np.nan, np.nan
    else:
        r, p = pearsonr(x, y)
    reliability.append({'channel': ch, 'r': r, 'p': p})

df_rel = pd.DataFrame(reliability)
df_rel.to_csv('channel_split_half_reliability.csv', index=False)

# Identify high reliability channels r>0.75
high_rel = df_rel[df_rel['r']>0.75]['channel'].tolist()

plt.show()

{"code":"import numpy as np
import h5py
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

# Parameters
sessions = range(1, 11)
epoch_tmin, epoch_tmax = -0.1, 0.3  # seconds
baseline = (-0.1, 0.0)
m100_window = (0.05, 0.15)  # seconds

# Collect latency per session and channel
records = []
for ses in sessions:
    with h5py.File(f'sub-0_ses-{ses}_meg.h5', 'r') as f:
        data = f['data'][:]; times = f['times'][:]
        ch_names = [c.strip() for c in f.attrs['channel_names'].split(',')]
        ch_types = [t.strip() for t in f.attrs['channel_types'].split(',')]
    mags = [i for i,t in enumerate(ch_types) if t=='mag']
    ev = pd.read_csv(f'sub-0_ses-{ses}_events.tsv', sep='\t')
    onsets = ev.loc[ev['kind']=='word','timemeg'].values
    # Epoch parameters
    sfreq = 1/(times[1]-times[0])
    n_samp = int(round((epoch_tmax-epoch_tmin)*sfreq)) + 1
    off = int(round(epoch_tmin * sfreq))
    b0 = int(round((baseline[0]-epoch_tmin)*sfreq)); b1 = int(round((baseline[1]-epoch_tmin)*sfreq))
    w0 = int(round((m100_window[0]-epoch_tmin)*sfreq)); w1 = int(round((m100_window[1]-epoch_tmin)*sfreq))
    # Extract epochs and compute evoked
    epochs = []
    for t0 in onsets:
        idx = np.searchsorted(times, t0) + off
        end = idx + n_samp
        if idx<0 or end>data.shape[1]: continue
        ep = data[mags, idx:end]
        ep = ep - ep[:, b0:b1].mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        epochs.append(ep)
    epochs = np.stack(epochs, axis=0)
    evoked = epochs.mean(axis=0)
    tvec = np.linspace(epoch_tmin, epoch_tmax, evoked.shape[1])
    # Latency per channel
    for ch_i, ch in enumerate(np.array(ch_names)[mags]):
        sig = evoked[ch_i, w0:w1]
        peak_idx = np.argmax(np.abs(sig))
        lat = tvec[w0 + peak_idx]
        records.append({'session': ses, 'channel': ch, 'latency': lat})

# Build DataFrame and pivot
df = pd.DataFrame(records)
df_pivot = df.pivot(index='session', columns='channel', values='latency')
channels = df_pivot.columns.tolist()

# Split-half reliability: sessions 1-5 vs 6-10
split1 = df_pivot.loc[1:5]
split2 = df_pivot.loc[6:10]
reliability = []
for ch in channels:
    x = split1[ch].values
    y = split2[ch].values
    if np.isnan(x).any() or np.isnan(y).any():
        r, p = np.nan, np.nan
    else:
        r, p = pearsonr(x, y)
    reliability.append({'channel': ch, 'r': r, 'p': p})

df_rel = pd.DataFrame(reliability)
df_rel.to_csv('channel_split_half_reliability.csv', index=False)

high_rel = df_rel[df_rel['r']>0.75]['channel'].tolist()

print(f'Channels with r>0.75 (n={len(high_rel)}): {high_rel}')
